run_eval_query_2dseg_inview: run the EvalQuery2dseg CLI tool to evaluate 2D segmentation using inview query mode on a checkpoint folder
run_eval_query_2dseg_crossview: run the EvalQuery2dseg CLI tool to evaluate 2D segmentation using crossview query mode with sampled features
run_eval_query_2dseg_custom_threshold: run the EvalQuery2dseg CLI tool with a custom fixed threshold value for 2D segmentation evaluation
run_eval_query_2dseg_gt_threshold: run the EvalQuery2dseg CLI tool using ground truth threshold mode for 2D segmentation evaluation
run_eval_query_2dseg_with_source_path: run the EvalQuery2dseg CLI tool with an optional source path to load model and scene configuration
